summary: The Hashdex Commodities Trust filed an 8-K reporting the completion of the liquidation of its Hashdex Bitcoin ETF. Trading had been suspended at the close on August 17, 2026, after which the sponsor sold all bitcoin positions in an OTC transaction to an unaffiliated third party. Cash proceeds were distributed pro rata to shareholders on August 24, 2026. No price per share or aggregate value was disclosed. The filing is a final asset disposition and cash distribution, indicating the ETF has ceased operations. Watch for the anticipated delisting of the DEFI shares and the fund's final termination.
